description: This file defines the class 'NewtonsoftJsonCodecOptions' which provides configurable options for a Newtonsoft.Json based codec in the Orleans serialization framework. It includes properties for serializer settings and delegate functions to determine serializability and copyability of types.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecOptions
classes.description: Options class for configuring a Newtonsoft.Json based serializer in Orleans, including JSON serializer settings and delegate functions for type support checks.
